review_state: production rev 1 - M1, awaiting owner look review
purpose: Creature world rock (PROPOSED): a rounded, mossy boulder about 1 m across with soft cleavage facets, warm grey stone and blue-green moss on its up-facing top.

dependencies.retrieved: kept in the repository since the M1 production rocks (docs/art/production_m1.md)
dependencies.use: grain (the diffuse scan's luminance, recoloured to the palette) and height (the displacement scan, as bump), box-projected on the boulder and baked; the scan's own colour is never shown

textures.name: T_CreatureBoulderA_ORM
textures.packing: R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

pivot: the boulder's centre on the ground (Godot y = 0); its base sinks 0.07 m so it sits into a slope
placement: an obstacle-sized rock: OUTSIDE the walls only (the berm and the hills, where max(|x|, |z|) is 80.5 m or more) until the sim has obstacles; tests/test_creature_world_art.gd keeps anything over 0.45 m out of the walkable field

reduction.method: Blender collapse decimation to the triangle budget; the full-detail shape and shader relief baked to the normal map

provenance: Authored procedurally by tools/blender/creature_flora.py (through make_creature_world.py); no external or generated meshes. Textures baked in Blender from procedural shaders over the CC0 Poly Haven Rock Boulder Dry scan (grain and height only, recoloured; see dependencies).
